node_dns_san: exactly one canonical lowercase node UUID
node_uri_san: exactly one urn:vortex:node:<same canonical node UUID>
common_name: same canonical node UUID, informational only; never authorizes without SAN and verified chain
private_key: node generated; signer matches certificate public key; no transmitted key
peer_validation: trusted role-specific CA and verified chain
expected peer identity and current authorized path membership
server_name: control Hub/backend expected DNS from trusted config; VLink expected peer node UUID as DNS plus canonical URI check
rotation: commit validated identity durably, then publish atomically; previous key only bounded overlap, never after NotAfter or revocation
session_resumption: disabled until fresh revocation and resumed peer identity checks are implemented and tested
compatibility: DNS-only legacy cert remains control-only; reject for lifecycle identity-v1/VLink, reissue through existing local CSR before enabling capability
